user.title: Connect ZTE Kids
user.description: Provide the ZTE Kids account used by themobile app.

reconfigure.title: Update ZTE Kids connection
reconfigure.description: Update the credentials for the existing ZTE Kids account.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect ZTE Kids
reauth_confirm.description: The ZTE Kids session for {name} was invalidated. Enter the account password to reconnect this integration.

error.captcha_required: This account currently requires an interactive captcha or verification challenge, which this integration cannot complete.
error.cannot_connect: The ZTE Kids backend rejected the login or could not be reached.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while validating the account.

abort.already_configured: This ZTE Kids account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The ZTE Kids integration reauthenticated successfully.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The ZTE Kids integration was updated successfully.
abort.wrong_account: Reconfiguration must use the same ZTE Kids account as the existing entry.

unknown_device.message: This ZTE Kids watch ({device_id}) is no longer in the account. Reload the integration if it was re-added.

command_failed.message: The ZTE Kids service rejected the command for {device}: {error}

command_too_soon.message: A command was just sent to {device}. Wait {seconds} seconds before sending another.

empty_message.message: The message is empty, so there is nothing to send.

message_too_long.message: The message is {length} characters. The watch accepts at most {maximum}.

schedule_incomplete.message: Set both ends of the power-off window before enabling it.

device_offline.message: {device} is not reachable right now. The watch has to be switched on and have a signal for commands to arrive.

init.title: ZTE Kids options
init.description: Real-time updates keep a connection open to the vendor's message broker, so location and battery arrive as they happen rather than on the polling interval. Polling continues underneath either way, so turning this off costs nothing but freshness.

set_sos_numbers.name: Set SOS numbers
set_sos_numbers.description: Replaces the numbers the watch calls when the SOS button is held. The watch stores all three together, so this is a single change; leave a number out to keep what it is now.

number_2.name: Second number
number_2.description: Called if the first does not answer.

set_power_off_schedule.name: Set power-off schedule
set_power_off_schedule.description: Sets the window in which the watch powers itself down, in the watch's own local time. The switch and both ends are written together.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the watch observes the window.

end_time.name: Power on at
end_time.description: When the watch starts up again.

set_shutdown_protection.name: Set shutdown protection
set_shutdown_protection.description: Requires a 4-digit code on the watch before it will power off. The setting and the code are stored together.

set_task_reminder.name: Set task reminder
set_task_reminder.description: Sets when the watch reminds the child about their tasks.

time.name: Time
time.description: When the reminder fires, in the watch's local time.

set_permissions.name: Set watch permissions
set_permissions.description: Turns whole features on or off on the watch itself. Most people never need this; turning location off stops the watch reporting where it is.

location.name: Location
location.description: Whether the watch reports its position.

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: Whether the watch reports its battery level.

sms.name: SMS
sms.description: Whether the watch handles text messages.
